## Why visit

A distinctive countryside alternative for visitors who want a brewery experience with a memorable setting. The converted farm stable block looks towards the reservoir and hills, while the brewery’s own range spans hop-forward beer, dark styles and more experimental releases. Cask and bottled real cider give it relevance beyond a modern keg taproom. In November, choose a daylight visit and arrange a dependable return: the scenery contributes much of the extra value, and this is a rural detour rather than a quick extension of central Manchester’s walking routes. Food vendors make a longer stop practical.

## Plan the visit

Official pattern is Wednesday–Sunday, with no table reservations. Plan transport and daylight; CAMRA records steps and non-accessible toilets.

**Getting there:** Rural Home Farm near Rivington: arrange the outward/return bus or taxi plan before setting out; no station-side access is implied.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
